The '''Kalandis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] found in the [[Pallis sector/Legends|Pallis sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis IV]].
